Type: table
Name: Rivet Mid-Century Modern End Table, 15.75"W, Walnut Stain
Add a modern flair to your home with this stunning end table. With a rich walnut stain, gold-capped tapered legs, and a unique chevron inlay on the drawer’s front panel, this table exudes distinct personality and will capture attention in any room. 15.75"W x 11.81"D x 23.62"H Engineered hardwood and fiberboard with brown ash veneer; rubber-wood legs with gold metal caps Modern style, with gold-tipped tapered legs, a gold drawer knob to match leg accents, and a chevron-design inlay on the front drawer panel This side table features 1 gliding drawer for storage next to your couch or bed. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
